description: Selection and held-out evaluation of a band-aware reduced map against the affine reduced map.

candidates.L0: signed e and z predict corrections to e+u and z; two coefficients per output per condition.
candidates.Hyb: L0 plus signed excess e beyond the configured band and z times the outside-band indicator; four coefficients per output per condition.

metrics.primary: per-seed mean absolute rollout error in signed log-price error e across held-out cells and ticks 1..20; positive paired difference means Hyb improves on L0.
secondary: one-step MAE in signed log-price error e
one-step MAE in normalized net-buy pressure z

uncertainty.method: paired percentile bootstrap over independent seeds

input_convention: u(t+1) = - CEX log return at t+1; e(t+1) includes the negative external reference move.
flow_forecast_limit: No next-tick stochastic order-flow realization is supplied as an input; z(t+1) is a state-only prediction of realized future noise/trend pressure.
scope: synthetic representative-agent simulator only; confirmation cells are unseen in both selection grid and seed range; no external-market or full-system stability claim
freeze_note: Freeze before running selection or confirmation. Any equation, feature, seed, cell, metric, or threshold change requires analysis_version 0.2.0 and a new untouched seed range.
